title: plugin-detail: the record page's Details tab draws a declared referenceVia pointer's type half (object_name) as its own row of stored API name, beside the card that names the same object by its label
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a user-visible machine name with a named producer on a served surface. Found by objectstack-ai/objectstack#24611's dev (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24698, open question 1; a static reading of objectui at objectstack's pin `12dc7b47c3`). Filed by objectstack `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-warren` · `session_01LR1cD9JqgkeqY7k9rrZH8s`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are this repository's triage's.

- **`reach:`** the default record page's Details tab of any object that declares a record pointer pair (`record_id` with `referenceVia: 'object_name'`). Today that means `sys_record_share`, `sys_share_link` and `sys_audit_log` (plugin-sharing, plugin-audit), and the approval objects (plugin-approvals).
- **What draws:** `record:details` (`RecordDetailView`, `deriveRecordDetailSections`) draws every visible field not in the strip or the H1. The id half draws as the record card headed by the target object's label (`DetailSection` → `RecordPreviewCard`, `useObjectLabel`). The type half (`object_name`, a `Field.text` holding the object's API name) also draws as its own row of stored text beside that card, so the page shows the API name next to the label that names the same object.
- **Why objectstack cannot fix it alone:** after objectstack-ai/objectstack#24698, `object_name` is in neither the strip nor the H1, so it lands in the Details tab. Hiding it per object needs a `hidden: true` on every pair's type half, which every author would have to remember.
- **The route objectstack's seat reads as right:** a render rule in `record:details` that folds a declared `referenceVia` type half into its id half's card and does not draw it as its own row. It is driven by the pair the spec already declares (`referenceVia` says the type half is part of one pointer), so it maps no name to anything. That is not the console-side mapping objectstack-ai/objectstack#24375 ruled out. This repository's triage decides.
- **Pin:** a record page for an object with a pointer pair, then the Details tab shows the card and no type-half row; an object without a pair is unchanged.

## Dedupe

objectui, MCP `search_issues` "record details tab referenceVia type half drawn as own row beside pointer card object_name API name": 9 hits, closed included. objectui#13036 (a list's `$select` missing the type half; fixed) and #12029 (the record-preview card itself) are the family. #8175 is `record:details`' dedupe of a declared `nameField`. None covers the type half drawn as its own Details row.

Dedupe words: Details tab object_name row API name; referenceVia type half record details row; pointer card type half duplicate.
